## Evidence

<!-- Required for any Brale API or Cloudflare claim. Link docs.brale.xyz, paste a live response, or cite the OpenAPI spec. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The claim is backed by a concrete failure or a verified source (not "I think")
- [ ] Any endpoint shape was checked against docs.brale.xyz, a live response, or the OpenAPI spec
- [ ] The recommendation lives in `guide/`; the story lives in the matching `lessons/` file
- [ ] If advice is architecture-specific, it says so and links `guide/concepts.md`
- [ ] No product names or links to private application repositories
- [ ] Links to public docs resolve
- [ ] Followed the "when X happens, update Y" table in `AGENTS.md`
